en: Colorized historic postcard view of a broad square with a large brick school building with a steep red roof and central tower in the background. In front of the school is a fenced green park area with trees, a column plastered with posters, and several children and adults standing on the sidewalk. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey residential or civic buildings with red roofs and classic European architecture. The title text is printed in red at the top of the card.
